profile_text.body:
Synopsys Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, trading under ticker SNPS and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000883241. Its website describes the company as delivering comprehensive silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs. The site highlights EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and systems verification.

The company's website mentions a 2026 announcement about advancing power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on Samsung Foundry processes at SAFE Forum 2026. The site also includes a notice that visitors may interact with an AI-powered chatbot providing general information about Synopsys products and services, and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers. Synopsys is named in 281 California legal matters.
